en.headline: Northern Metropolis Marathon draws 15,000 as traffic plans announced
en.dek: The Heung Yee Kuk’s first marathon on 1 November will close sections of roads including Lung Shan Tunnel and Fanling Bypass, with early MTR services arranged.
body: The Heung Yee Kuk said about 15,000 people have signed up for the inaugural Northern Metropolis Marathon on 1 November, which includes full marathon, half marathon, 10-kilometre and 1.6-kilometre events.

The full marathon starts at the Heung Yee Kuk building in Shek Mun, Sha Tin, passes the Science Park waterfront, Tolo Highway and Lung Shan Tunnel, and finishes on Fanling Bypass. The half marathon starts at Science Park and also ends on Fanling Bypass. Organisers said the route would showcase the Northern Metropolis.

The Transport Department has announced temporary road closures and public transport diversions. Lung Shan Tunnel northbound is expected to reopen around 11am, while Fanling Bypass southbound is expected to reopen around 3pm. Several bus and green minibus routes will be diverted or suspended in phases.

To support participants, the MTR East Rail Line between Hung Hom and Sheung Shui and the Tuen Ma Line between Tai Wai and Wu Kai Sha will start earlier that morning, with the first East Rail train from Hung Hom to Sheung Shui departing at 4.20am.

zh.headline: 北都馬拉松吸引約1.5萬人 當局公布交通安排
zh.dek: 鄉議局11月1日首辦北部都會區馬拉松，龍山隧道及粉嶺繞道部分路段將臨時封閉，港鐵提早開出首班車。
body: 新界鄉議局表示，11月1日舉行的首屆北部都會區馬拉松已吸引約1.5萬人報名，賽事設全馬、半馬、10公里及1600米組別。
全馬由沙田石門新界鄉議局大樓起步，途經科學園海濱長廊、吐露港公路及龍山隧道，終點設於粉嶺繞道。半馬則由科學園起步，同樣以粉嶺繞道為終點。主辦方表示希望透過賽事展現北部都會區的活力。
運輸署已公布臨時封路及公共交通改道安排。龍山隧道北行預計上午11時左右解封，粉嶺繞道南行預計下午3時左右解封。多條巴士及小巴路線將分階段改道或暫停。
為方便參賽者，港鐵東鐵綫紅磧至上水段及屯馬綫大圍至烏溪沙段當日會提早開出首班車，紅磧往上水的首班東鐵將於凌晨4時20分開出。
